title: US Divorce Nearly Halved As First Marriage Moved Later
hook: Divorce nearly halved while Americans delayed first marriage.
closing: The trends moved together, but the data cannot prove that waiting caused the decline.
question: Why do you think divorce fell?

segments.say: The US divorce rate fell to 2.4 per thousand, nearly half its earlier level.
US women now first marry at 28.6, showing marriage timing shifted alongside the divorce decline.
